title: Prism Tumbler
pages: Craft the rotating drum from a Clutch-Brake Pack, a Roller-Chain Sprocket Drive, a Jaw Shaft Coupling and a Metered Grease Unit, tinted glass, a barrel, the Prism Separator and two Plummer-Block Bearing Housings. Each split housing is assembled around a Deep-Groove Ball Bearing from sealed steel side plates, a Riveted Brace cap, iron ingot fasteners and a Labyrinth Seal below the bearing. Craft two seals from two copper ingots, two tin ingots and one Bearing Grease: the interleaved copper and tin rings never touch the shaft, and the grease-packed gaps keep tumbling grit and slurry out of the bearing. Separate two raw porkchops in the Prism Separator to obtain Rendered Tallow and a cooked porkchop byproduct. Combine the tallow with a clay ball to make two portions of grease; clay thickens the fat so it stays in the ring grooves. Raw slime cannot replace the grease, and an iron nugget cannot replace the seal. Make the bearing from hardened races and pressed balls as described under Magnetizer; make the brace in the Hydraulic Riveter. The housings support the drum at both sides; loose bearings or flint cannot replace them. Put tinted glass blocks directly west and east of the drum; missing or unloaded blocks halt work. Assemble the Metered Grease Unit from a Bath Circulation Pump, Bourdon Pressure Gauge, Bearing Grease, four copper ingots as distribution lines, redstone and a Sealed Steel Plate. Put it in the lower left of the controller craft. The pump distributes grease to both housings; the gauge indicates pressure, while the game abstracts metering and does not simulate blocked lines. A plain fourth plate or splash-oil gearbox cannot replace this unit.

Craft the Jaw Shaft Coupling from two Drive Shafts, two Shaft Keys, four Sealed Steel Plates and a slime-ball elastomer spider. The keyed half-hubs join the drum shaft to its drive across a small flexible gap. Broach Tool Steel Stock into Shaft Keys; a bare shaft or plate does not make the coupling. The game abstracts shaft alignment, torque and spider wear. The pump is made by hot pressing the Monel Pump Blank; see Silvering Bath for that route. For the drum drive, form two Flanged Rings in the Flange Press, head two Aluminum Rivets in the Hydraulic Riveter, and join them with a chain. The formed rings act as sprockets and rivets pin the chain links. Fit the drive at the upper left of the Tumbler craft; a loose plate or iron ingot cannot replace it. The chain carries positive drum torque while the Jaw Shaft Coupling accommodates alignment. Chain pitch, tension and wear are abstracted.

Feed 20-40 FE/t or crank. Top and horizontal ports import, bottom exports; configure each face in the menu. Inventory, power, progress and ports persist. JEI lists twenty datapack recipes that round stone into polished blocks, break clusters and grind bone, ore and glass.
Tumble a Refracted Matrix into a Tumbled Prism Bead. The bead replaces the left quartz edge of the Prism Burnisher craft, so it gates that apparatus without a cycle.

Fit a Clutch-Brake Pack at the upper right of the controller craft. Press two leather hides into one Pressed Friction Lining at the Press, then sandwich it between two Sealed Steel Plates with a Coil Spring return and a keyed Jaw Shaft Coupling. This pack engages and stops the loaded drum; a loose plate or raw hide cannot substitute. The game abstracts friction wear, torque rating and braking distance. Feed the press above and extract the lining below to automate the route.
